template.title: The Lost Toy and the Friendly Kite
template.summary: A child loses a toy in the park, finds help from a friendly animal, and shares a snack to end the day happily.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the park.
One sunny day, the [[slot_toy]] slid down the slide and fell into the big green [[slot_forest]].
[[slot_child]] looked everywhere but could not find the [[slot_toy]].
[[slot_child]] felt sad and thought about walking home.
Then a friendly [[slot_pet]] hopped over with a bright [[slot_color]] kite.
The kite fluttered like a dragonfly and made a soft humming sound.
[[slot_pet]] sniffed the air and said, "Let me help!"
Together they searched under the [[slot_color]] kite and found the [[slot_toy]] hidden inside a fluffy cloud of cotton candy.
[[slot_child]] thanked the [[slot_pet]] and shared a crunchy [[slot_snack]].
They all played a game of tag in the park.
The [[slot_child]] felt happy, and the [[slot_pet]] wagged its tail.
At the end of the day, they promised to meet again.
